name: mirage
text: That screenshot shows the engine restart I started at 17:05 UTC so it would run the Kalshi fix. The old engine shut down cleanly, but the new one is queued behind it: GitHub is still closing out the old run, now for about 8 minutes. I'm leaving it alone because cancelling mid-wrap-up can lose the engine's saved data. If it isn't running within about 10 more minutes, I'll replace the runner myself. Wallet, bids and trading come back with it, and nothing was lost while it was down.
